environment: **Organization**: Example Org keeps its code in private repositories.
**Repository visibility**: Treat every repository as private unless told otherwise.
**Trusted repo**: The git repository the session starts in and its configured remotes.
**Source control**: The trusted repo and its remotes only.
allow: Test runs: running the project's own test command is allowed.
Local edits: editing files inside the working directory is allowed.
soft_deny: Force push: never force push a shared branch.
Production deploy: never deploy to production.
hard_deny: Credential leakage: never send credentials to a remote host.
